summary: Comprehensive testing of Warehouse Storage Locations and Fixed Assets features. All 15 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified for both tabs including hierarchical warehouse display and fixed assets management.

storage_locations_tab.description: Hierarchical storage locations display with center-based grouping

tests.test: Shows 6 centers (زيك, حجيف, غدو, طاقة, ثمريت, مرباط)
Warehouse categories displayed (أعلاف, معدات, مستلزمات, مختبر, صيانة, تنظيف)

add_warehouse_dialog.description: Dialog for adding new warehouse with center and parent selection

fixed_assets_tab.description: Fixed assets management with statistics and table view

tests.test: Shows statistics cards (إجمالي الأصول, نشطة, في الصيانة, تحتاج صيانة)
Filter dropdowns for category and status
Assets table with columns (رمز الأصل, الاسم, النوع, الموقع, الحالة, الحالة الفنية, إجراءات)
View and Transfer action buttons visible

add_asset_dialog.description: Dialog for adding new fixed asset with warehouse and location selection

backend_apis.description: All warehouse and fixed assets APIs working correctly

tests.test: Response has correct structure with 6 centers
POST /api/warehouse/fixed-assets creates asset with auto-generated code

critical_code_review_comments: StorageLocationsSection component (line 2186): Correctly implements hierarchical display with external warehouses first, then internal
FixedAssetsSection component (line 2413): Properly fetches assets and stats with filter support
warehouse_routes.py: All CRUD operations for warehouses and fixed assets working correctly
Initialize warehouses API creates 54 warehouses across 6 centers with proper parent-child relationships
Fixed asset transfer creates movement record and updates asset location
seed_data_creation: Created test warehouses and fixed assets during API testing (prefixed with TEST_)
